description.value: As an Action on your turn, you may create a number of clones up to your Proficieny Bonus for 2 Stamina per clone. These clones dissipate as a free action whenever you choose or after 1 minute passes. These clones are extensions of you and share all of your current Resources, Features, Forms, and Conditions. At the end of your turn you may have any number of clones move up to your Movement Speed and take a single Action or Bonus Action that you can take.
